motivation: Test whether factoring out the order-3 endomorphism phi(x,y) = (beta*x, y) yields further reduction in bounded DLP.
derivation: phi(k*G) = (lambda*k)*G. On Z_n, scalar maps to lambda*k (mod n).
result: FALSIFIED: Minimum displacement in endomorphism direction is ~2^126 bits. Endomorphism baby steps have strictly zero collision with 1D bounded giant steps across all tested N in [2^4, 2^20].
